en.title: Gradido Chat

setup.intro: Sign in to Gradido in your browser and copy your token from there.
setup.tokenHint: In the browser: developer tools → console → JSON.parse(localStorage['gradido-frontend']).token
setup.keep: Keep the token in the keyring
setup.noKeyring: This device has no keyring: the token lasts only while the program runs.
setup.failedToken: The token is no longer valid. Please copy a fresh one.

menu.tray: Stay in the tray when closed

en.pickOne: Pick a contact or a group on the left.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hardwareHint: Draws with the graphics card instead of the processor. Applies from the next start of the program.
